g1|variants|returnable packaging.summary: This family covers the end-to-end handling of customer-owned or company-owned returnable packaging items (such as pallets and containers) from delivery and customer site tracking to physical return and credit processing. The variants differ primarily by whether the packaging is managed via standard sales and delivery processing with special stock, or as value-only items, and how the subsequent return or permanent loss is settled.

variants.name: Standard Returnable Packaging Delivery with Special Stock
variants.when_used: Shipping goods to a customer on reusable pallets or containers tracked in customer special stock (V) until returned.
variants.key_config: Item category TANN is configured as delivery-relevant and special stock indicator V, posting to unrestricted special stock at customer.

variants.name: Returnable Packaging Pick-up / Return
variants.when_used: Customer physically returns empty returnable packaging materials to the supplying plant.
variants.key_config: Return order type KA uses item category KLN with movement type 622 to bring stock back from customer special stock into own inventory.

variants.name: Returnable Packaging Issue / Empty Pick-up
variants.when_used: Issuing empty returnable packaging independently of a goods delivery (e.g. initial stock provision).
variants.key_config: Order type KB configured for standalone returnable packaging issue without accompanying trade goods.

variants.name: Customer Pick-up / Scrapping of Unreturned Packaging
variants.when_used: Packaging is lost, damaged, or purchased by the customer, requiring conversion from customer special stock to scrap or billing.
variants.key_config: Special movement types or billing requests to clear customer special stock account and raise a replacement charge.

compare_groups.covers: Special stock indicator V, customer consignment or packaging stock balance tracking in MMBE / MM03.

g1|core|returnable packaging|standard re.title: Standard Returnable Packaging Delivery with Special Stock
g1|core|returnable packaging|standard re.story: Imagine lending your favorite toy to a friend with the strict agreement that they must give it back later, while you keep track of who currently has it in a special box. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash, this process ships returnable packaging materials to a customer using special stock, manages the physical container as customer-owned inventory (Special Stock Indicator V) without billing for the packaging itself, and tracks the obligation for the customer to return it.
g1|core|returnable packaging|standard re.why_business_needs_it: Companies need to ship valuable returnable transport items (like pallets, racks, or gas cylinders) to customers alongside or inside sales orders without forcing the customer to purchase them. This ensures accurate inventory tracking of customer-owned special stock and supports subsequent return processes to prevent asset loss.

config_steps.step: Define Item Category TANN for Returnable Packaging
config_steps.where: VOV7 -- SPRO > Sales and Distribution > Sales Documents > Sales Document Item > Define Item Categories
config_steps.values: Item category: TANN; Item type: Standard item; Billing relevance: blank; Special stock indicator: V; Pricing: B
config_steps.check: Run SE16N on table TSIT to confirm item category TANN exists with billing relevance blank.
config_steps.why: This setting ensures the system handles the returnable packaging without charging the customer for it while keeping track of inventory.
config_steps.if_missing: Without this item category, the system will either expect billing or fail to recognize special stock, resulting in incorrect financial postings.
actions: Enter /nVOV7 in the command field and press Enter
Select item category TAN and click Copy As (F6)
Overwrite Item Category with TANN and Name with "Returnable Packaging Item"
Set Item type to Standard item
Set Billing relevance to blank
Set Special stock indicator to V
Set Pricing to B
Save (Ctrl+S) and assign a customizing transport request

g1|panel|returnable packaging.otc_impact: Returnable packaging in Order-to-Cash manages customer-owned or company-owned pallets, containers, and racks across deliveries, customer sites, and returns, tracking physical inventory as special stock while posting no revenue on the outbound movement. It changes OTC by introducing special item categories that trigger valuation-free goods issues and special stock segments (V_T685A / MSKA) without altering billing documents, ensuring customers are only invoiced for unreturned assets via subsequent debit memos or charges. Without this integration, reusable assets disappear from inventory visibility, physical stock reconciliations fail, and manual tracking leads to lost container revenue and strained customer relationships.

panel_qa.question: How do we handle unreturned pallets when a customer refuses to send them back or loses them, and how does this flow through OTC to Finance?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: When returnable packaging items remain with the customer past the agreed threshold, we execute a scrapping or customer purchase scenario using a subsequent debit or sales order for the lost material value. SAP handles this by converting the special stock O quantity into standard material consumption or a sales charge via item category TAN or custom billing-relevant categories. The leadership value is automated asset recovery billing, eliminating manual credit-debit adjustments and protecting working capital tied up in transport equipment. Next, we will implement periodic automated notifications and debit memo requests via background jobs to accelerate unreturned asset billing. The weak answer to avoid is telling the CFO we just write off the packaging in MM without billing the customer.
panel_qa.trap: We just write off the packaging in inventory management without involving sales or billing.

panel_qa.question: What is the architectural flow and document chain for delivering goods on returnable pallets versus picking up empty ones from a customer site?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: The outbound delivery uses special stock indicator V for customer returnable packaging, generating a 601 V movement type that reduces company-owned special stock at the customer location without hitting financial revenue. For the return pick-up, we create a returns delivery with movement type 651 V to bring the empty packaging back into unrestrictedly-useable or returnable special stock. Key configuration involves item category group LEER assigned to item categories like DLN for delivery and REN for returns via schedule line category mapping in VOV6. This structure maintains strict inventory traceability per customer without generating false financial liabilities or asset sales. Next, we ensure warehouse management (WM/EWM) putaway rules correctly route returned empty containers to dedicated storage bins. The weak answer to avoid is treating returnable packaging as normal sales items with standard pricing.
panel_qa.trap: We treat returnable packaging as normal sales items with standard pricing and revenue posting.

panel_qa.question: How do we prevent inventory discrepancies between our SAP system and what the customer actually holds on their shop floor?
panel_qa.how_to_answer: We enforce regular customer-specific special stock reconciliations using transaction MB5B and SD report RFOWRE00 to match physical pallet balances with table MSKA entries. SAP enforces data integrity by locking returnable packaging accounts to specific customer master records in XD03/BP, ensuring no anonymous stock mixing occurs. The leadership value is preventing stock write-offs and maintaining transparent asset accountability that improves audit compliance. Next, we will roll out a customer portal dashboard showing real-time pallet balances to drive proactive returns. The weak answer to avoid is stating that inventory discrepancies are resolved solely during annual physical inventory counts.
panel_qa.trap: We reconcile customer packaging balances only during annual physical inventory counts.

avoid_issues.issue: Customer master records lack authorization or default settings for handling special stock, causing delivery creation dumps.
avoid_issues.avoid: Ensure customer master sales area views and partner functions are fully maintained with correct shipping conditions and special stock flags.
